checkout.title: Review your purchase
checkout.description: Check the price, then continue to Stripe to pay.
checkout.note: You pay on Stripe’s secure page with a card or Link. Prices include VAT. Your card details never reach Local WorkMan.

ai.title: Unlock your AI insights

job_alerts.title: Get job alerts by email

discovery.title: Build your shortlist
discovery.lead: Shortlists, search and Compare candidates are part of Recruiter Plus. Candidates you shortlisted before are kept.

return.title: Confirming your payment
return.problemTitle: We could not confirm a payment
return.confirming: Stripe has your payment. We are confirming it and will take you back in a moment.
return.notPaid: This payment was not completed, so nothing was charged.
return.missing: This page needs a payment reference from Stripe.
return.slow: Your payment is taking longer than usual to confirm. It will show in Billing as soon as Stripe confirms it.
return.stepApplyHint: We are adding it to your account.
return.stepBackHint: You return to the page you started from.
return.secure: Processed securely by Stripe. Your card details never reach Local WorkMan.
